## MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the Current Market Regime?**
RISK-ON environment as volatility is low at 17.5% and breadth is broad with 8/8 sectors positive. Market is in a strong bullish phase driven by cyclicals and large-cap participation.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology & Telecom leading: TTKOM (1W: +19.78% | 1M: +7.99%) ABOVE TREND, KONTR (1W: +8.70% | 1M: -8.62%) RECOVERY. Energy & Chemicals following: SASA (1W: +26.46% | 1M: +13.25%) ABOVE TREND, PETKM (1W: +22.06% | 1M: +32.62%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Holding & Investment is the softest among winners: KCHOL (1W: +4.21% | 1M: +9.57%) ABOVE TREND, SAHOL (1W: +2.47% | 1M: +7.99%) ABOVE TREND. Transportation is the mild lag: THYAO (1W: +3.00% | 1M: -2.75%) RECOVERY, PGSUS (1W: +4.05% | 1M: +1.51%) ABOVE TREND.

## STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
SASA (1W: +26.46% | 1M: +13.25%) ABOVE TREND, PETKM (1W: +22.06% | 1M: +32.62%) ABOVE TREND, TTKOM (1W: +19.78% | 1M: +7.99%) ABOVE TREND, SISE (1W: +16.29% | 1M: +9.81%) ABOVE TREND, TOASO (1W: +15.07% | 1M: +11.74%) ABOVE TREND.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
THYAO (1W: +3.00% | 1M: -2.75%) RECOVERY, TSKB (1W: +2.90% | 1M: +2.81%) ABOVE TREND, SAHOL (1W: +2.47% | 1M: +7.99%) ABOVE TREND, YKBNK (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +2.80%) ABOVE TREND, DOHOL (1W: +2.15% | 1M: +1.48%) ABOVE TREND.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Biggest 1W movers: SASA (1W: +26.46% | 1M: +13.25%) ABOVE TREND, PETKM (1W: +22.06% | 1M: +32.62%) ABOVE TREND, TTKOM (1W: +19.78% | 1M: +7.99%) ABOVE TREND, SISE (1W: +16.29% | 1M: +9.81%) ABOVE TREND, TOASO (1W: +15.07% | 1M: +11.74%) ABOVE TREND.

## SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Banking Sector Outlook?**
Banks are participating but momentum is moderate; ISCTR (1W: +7.57% | 1M: +10.91%) ABOVE TREND and VAKBN (1W: +12.86% | 1M: +23.16%) ABOVE TREND lead, while AKBNK (1W: +1.61% | 1M: +5.67%) ABOVE TREND and GARAN (1W: +2.13% | 1M: +2.44%) ABOVE TREND show steady catch-up.

**8. Industrial Sector Outlook?**
Heavy industry is strong and broad-based: TOASO (1W: +15.07% | 1M: +11.74%) ABOVE TREND, FROTO (1W: +9.52% | 1M: +3.89%) ABOVE TREND, EREGL (1W: +7.71% | 1M: +5.97%) ABOVE TREND, ASELS (1W: +3.55% | 1M: +3.35%) ABOVE TREND.

**9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?**
Energy & Chemicals are market leaders on commodity and margin relief: SASA (1W: +26.46% | 1M: +13.25%) ABOVE TREND, PETKM (1W: +22.06% | 1M: +32.62%) ABOVE TREND, TUPRS (1W: +5.75% | 1M: +17.72%) ABOVE TREND, SISE (1W: +16.29% | 1M: +9.81%) ABOVE TREND.

## PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Overweight cyclicals and select energy/industrial names while trimming positions that lag relative to the new highs; favor momentum names with clear 1M confirmation like PETKM and TUPRS. Maintain core bank exposure for yield and rotate a portion of cash into technology names showing strong 1W gains like TTKOM.

## NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
PETKM (1W: +22.06% | 1M: +32.62%) ABOVE TREND, SASA (1W: +26.46% | 1M: +13.25%) ABOVE TREND, TTKOM (1W: +19.78% | 1M: +7.99%) ABOVE TREND, TOASO (1W: +15.07% | 1M: +11.74%) ABOVE TREND, VAKBN (1W: +12.86% | 1M: +23.16%) ABOVE TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
Energy & Chemicals for continued commodity-driven upside, Technology & Telecom for momentum-led flows, and Heavy Industry for cyclicals catching the rally. Monitor breadth within these sectors for signs of exhaustion.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch for continued market confirmation via higher highs on XU100 and volume expansion on leaders; monitor Turkish CPI and any CBRT commentary as primary catalysts. Technical triggers: sustained closes above 20-day moving averages on PETKM, SASA and TOASO and any rotation into lagging banks as risk-on confirmation.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
RISK-ON market with low volatility and unanimous sector breadth; cyclicals and energy names are leading. Trade idea: overweight PETKM/SASA/TOASO and selective banks, but trim positions lacking 1M confirmation and watch macro catalysts for reversal risk.
